_comment: Committed CI floors for the replay-mode regression gate (D6). Floors are calibrated ~5pp UNDER the measured rates (~2.4pp == 1 in-scope case at n=42, ~3.4pp == 1 out-of-scope case at n=29, leaving temperature=0 re-capture jitter room). Measured baseline (report.json @ prompt_version 1a12f4d66e08159b, 2026-06-17, 71 cases, bank_version 3): T2_semantic_valid 1.00 (42/42), T4_answer_correct 0.976 (41/42), out_of_scope_honest 1.00 (29/29), adversarial-safe 8/8. bank_version 3 added the `scene` shape (describe_scene primitive, 5 cases): all 4 in-scope scene cases reach T4, the injection case grounds out, and oos honest-refusal held at 1.00 (no over-refusal regression from the capability widening). KNOWN REGRESSION, deliberately HELD not de-ratcheted: bernabeu-presence-far-2 ('Does this frame contain at least one footballer?') mis-routes detect -> count -> answer ('5' != 'Yes') after the #52 budget-driven count/scope prose trim; the T4 floor is kept at 0.95 (still cleared at 0.976) rather than lowered to ~0.93, pending a presence/count routing fix (follow-up). min_fixtures == bank size (71 since bank_version 3); new cases are captured on their PR branch before merge, so the committed set stays uniform. Keys: in-scope tier rates (over in-scope cases that are not stale/missing), the out-of-scope honest-refusal rate, min_fixtures (catches deletion), max_stale (partial-staleness tolerance; uniform all-stale downgrades to advisory).
